signal.primary: MIX long0.9gross iff current first-monthly-release Wednesday reserves exceed first release3calendar months earlier; otherwise cash
signal.control: constant MIX long0.9gross on the identical valid-source calendar; never promote the control after outcomes
signal.decision: 18:45Moscow completed day, latest available release; next actual daily open. Stale entry cancelled at fill; no future exit/session filter.
